_about: Hand-picked 'Community-Driven' farms. 'tiers' covers every relic of that era; add an entry under 'relics' (e.g. "Neo T5": {...}) to override one relic. Fields: n = node, p = planet, t = mission type, r = rotation (optional), note = short tip (optional). After you edit this file the data workflow merges it into data/relics.json and every app picks it up on next launch.
